purpose: Closed asset manifest for implementation. Use only listed source files; do not generate substitutions.

driveMirror.rule: Every approved asset used by Kingfisher must remain available in the Kingfisher Google Drive folder and be versioned in this repository. GitHub is not the sole media archive.
driveMirror.releaseRule: Before an asset is added or replaced, record its Drive file reference or approved folder, Drive revision when available, and SHA-256 in the corresponding asset-release record.

fonts.rule: Cormorant Garamond for display greetings; Inter for interface text and the approved Today section headings (SDR-014).

icons.rule: Never use a different icon library, an emoji, a Unicode symbol or generated icon artwork.

media.rule: Use media only where a canonical screen shows an image-led space. Do not add decorative media to routine cards.

missingAssetProtocol: ASSET-REQUEST: purpose, target screen, dimensions, reason no approved asset fits.

approvedDeviations.SDR-014: Product owner selected the second final proposal on 2026-09-27: continuous landscape, opaque panels, Inter headings, pill controls, flying kingfisher, refined shared navigation marks. Three generated raster assets and one canonical screen are explicitly approved for this implementation; see ASSET-RELEASE-2026-09-27.md. Other legacy asset restrictions remain in force.
